# Genshin Damage Calculator

> Free Genshin Impact damage calculator for every character. Edit the six damage multipliers (base, DMG bonus, CRIT, reaction, DEF, RES) and see how each one changes the final number. Character + weapon only, no artifacts.

Independent fan-made web tool. Damage values are computed from the official six-multiplier formula; data is refreshed within 48 hours of each version patch. No signup, no download, no paywall.

## Core content

- [Genshin Damage Calculator (home)](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/): A single-character calculator built from the six damage multipliers — each independently editable, with a live formula chain and per-zone contribution. Character + weapon only (no artifacts).
- [Damage Formula Guide](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/guides/damage-formula/): The six-multiplier damage formula breakdown, DEF/RES math, and elemental reaction coefficients (Vaporize ×1.5, Melt ×2.0, EM scaling).
- [Character Build Guide](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/guides/builds/): Weapon comparisons, artifact set picks, constellation value tiers, and talent priority ranked by computed damage impact.
- [How to Increase Damage](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/guides/improve-damage/): Buffs by multiplier impact, common build mistakes, and how to raise your damage.

## Site info

- [About](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/about/): Who builds the tool (Kai Ren), the calculation methodology, data sources, and the independence statement.
- [Contact](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/contact/): How to report bugs, wrong damage numbers, or missing presets by email or GitHub issues.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/privacy/): No accounts, nothing you enter leaves your browser, anonymous GA4 analytics.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.genshindamagecalculator.com/terms/): Estimates only, no warranty, trademark and non-affiliation notices.

## Key facts

- The damage formula is: Base damage (scaling stat × talent multiplier) × (1 + DMG Bonus) × CRIT × Reaction × DEF × RES.
- Amplifying reactions: Vaporize ×1.5, Melt ×2.0; Elemental Mastery scales by 2.78 × EM ÷ (EM + 1400).
- Transformative reactions ignore ATK and CRIT; they scale with level and EM (level-90 multiplier 1446.85).
- Data snapshot targets version 7.0 (Snezhnaya, launched August 12, 2026); data is refreshed within 48 hours of each version patch and new characters are added as they release.
- Independent fan-made tool, not affiliated with HoYoverse/miHoYo/Cognosphere.
